kidney_failure.warning: Reduced renal clearance — drug accumulation risk is elevated. Dose reduction may be required.

liver_disease.warning: Impaired hepatic metabolism — CYP enzyme activity is reduced. Interaction risk is significantly elevated.

diabetes.warning: Glycemic control may be affected by this drug combination. Blood sugar monitoring is advised.

heart_failure.warning: Cardiac conduction may be affected. QTc prolongation risk is elevated in heart failure patients.

hypertension.warning: Blood pressure control may be disrupted by this combination. Monitor BP closely.

copd.warning: Respiratory function may be further compromised by this drug combination.
